The '''Tribunal''' was a collection of former [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] operating on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]<ref name="TOR" /> in the year [[3626 BBY]]<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref> which sought to bring law and order to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TOR" />

Of the individuals on the tribunal was the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Jek-Burz]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Navolii]], and a Tribunal Elder named [[Jozdit]].<ref name="TOR" />
